rows.label: Value of averting the death of a child under five (GiveWell)

source.title: GiveWell, Against Malaria Foundation CEA (September 2026), moral weights row
source.cell: Value assigned to averting a malaria-attributable death of a child under 5

rows.explainer:
GiveWell's moral weight for averting one death of a child under five, in units of value (one unit = doubling one person's consumption for a year). It comes from GiveWell's moral weights work: donor surveys, a survey of people in Ghana and Kenya, and staff judgment.

Models multiply it by `$life_value_multiplier`, so a visitor can scale every life value at once. Use this fact for any under-five death averted, so charityevals' own models value a child's life the same way GiveWell's do.

rows.label: Value of averting the death of a person aged five or older (GiveWell)

source.title: GiveWell, Against Malaria Foundation CEA (September 2026), moral weights row
source.cell: Value assigned to averting a malaria-attributable death of a person age 5 or older

rows.explainer:
GiveWell's moral weight for averting one death at age five or over, weighted by the age profile of malaria deaths. It is lower than the under-five value because GiveWell gives less weight to deaths of older people.

It is a reasonable default for deaths of older children and adults when no age-specific weight is available; say so in the model when you use it. Multiply by `$life_value_multiplier`.
